problems.title: Guess Number

source.preview_scope: group-level; not a complete variant specification

inference_basis_fields: contentPreview: GuessServer.guessNumber returns exact position matches; 4-digit secret with leading zeros
problems.inferred_spec: Interactive problem modelled as a deterministic transcript. A simulated server holds secret (4 digits, leading zeros allowed) and answers a 4-digit guess with the number of positions where guess and secret agree. Return every guess the following strategy makes, in order. Phase 1: for d = 0, 1, ... stop when the known digit counts already sum to 4; for d = 9 infer its count without a guess; otherwise guess dddd to learn the count of d, and stop at once if the answer is 4. Phase 2: let f be the smallest digit with count 0. For each position p = 0..3, with D the ascending distinct digits still unplaced: if D has one digit it is at p; else for each d in D except the last, guess the string with d at p and f elsewhere, and if the answer is 1 place d at p; if no guess hits, place the last. Phase 3: guess the secret itself (answer 4) unless the last guess already was.
problems.inference_uncertainty: very high: the official task is interactive and likely accepts any strategy within a budget; the transcript output and this exact strategy are modelling choices for exact comparison
problems.effects: arguments (including nested containers) unchanged; fresh returned containers
